mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_order (work_order_id, item_id, equipment_id, plan_qty, start_date, end_date, status) VALUES (#{workOrderNo}, #{itemId}, #{equipmentId}, #{planQty}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT wo.work_order_id, wo.work_order_no, wo.item_id, wo.equipment_id, wo.plan_qty, wo.start_date, wo.end_date, wo.status, wo.created_at, i.item_name, e.equipment_name FROM work_order wo JOIN item i ON i.item_id = wo.item_id JOIN equipment e ON e.equipment_id = wo.equipment_id WHERE wo.work_order_id = (#{workOrderId})
